strategy_catalog.name: WorkspaceQueue Pattern - Principles
strategy_catalog.natural_language: Replace raw CrossCoreSetFlag/WaitFlag with a typed WorkspaceQueue class that encapsulates workspace ring-buffer management. WorkspaceQueue provides ProducerAcquire() to get the next slot, ProducerReleaseFix() or ProducerReleaseMte3() to signal completion, and ConsumerAcquire() which waits with the correct PIPE_MTE2 mode.

principles.description: Use the minimal pipeline scope for each sync: FIX for S/O output (Fixpipe completion), MTE3 for P output (DataCopy completion), MTE2 for AIV consumption
principles.rationale: Eliminates mismatch between producer pipeline (FIX/MTE3) and consumer pipeline (MTE2), preserving overlap for unrelated channels

principles.description: Encapsulate slot offset calculation (head/tail % RING_SLOTS * slotSize) in the queue class, eliminating manual offset tracking errors
principles.rationale: Manual offset calculation is error-prone; encapsulation ensures correct slot indexing across PRELAUNCH tiles

principles.description: Producer side (AIC) uses Acquire/Release; Consumer side (AIV) uses Acquire with wait
principles.rationale: Clear separation of roles prevents sync misuse: producer signals completion, consumer waits for readiness

performance_bottlenecks.description: Original CrossCoreSetFlag/WaitFlag uses PIPE_ALL, draining all pipeline channels
performance_bottlenecks.impact: Destroys pipeline overlap, adding ~20-30 cycles delay per sync

performance_bottlenecks.description: Each tile requires manual wsOffset = slot * BLOCK_M * BLOCK_N calculation
performance_bottlenecks.impact: Scalar computation overhead per tile, ~5-10 cycles
